description:
STEP 3 (collapse the matchers). Once the calculator carries the trichotomy and structural-mismatch verdicts (fz-hwn.27.4), contract.rs's bespoke witness/substitution walk is replaced by it -- and the hand-rolled machinery marked Trash in the intro is deleted.

Remove (proposal "Kill with fire", group C):
- instantiate_matching_arrow, overlapping_witnesses, contract_witness   (contract.rs:137,158,173)
- instantiate_match, instantiated_match, surface_sigma, merge_sigma     (contract.rs:182,232,239,477)
- collect_contract_subst + collect_{var,tuple,list,resource,map,arrow}_subst   (contract.rs:247-475)
- collect_ambiguous_empty_list_vars                                     (contract.rs:321)
- enum Witness, enum SchemeInstantiation                                (contract.rs:108,121)
Replace ContractArrow/AppliedContractArrow/SchemeMatch/FunctionContract surface containers with the addressed arrow Ty + bounds sidecar (group A).

All matching becomes a calculator decision on interned addressed arrows; contract application instantiates the arrow via the bounds sidecar.

Depends on: calculator extension (fz-hwn.27.4), convergence key-derivation (fz-hwn.27.7).
Checks: contract/overload-resolution fixtures green via the calculator (no bespoke witness walk); the group-A/group-C Trash symbols in contract.rs are gone. Lib + matrix green, zero warnings.
title: Collapse contract.rs witness/substitution walk onto the extended Types calculator
